transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad to meet you. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been dealing with constant, uncontrollable worry about almost everything in my life for about eight months now. It's starting to feel really overwhelming and I just can't seem to turn it off.
Along with this worry, have you also been feeling persistently down or depressed, or have you lost interest in the things you normally enjoy?
No, I haven't really been feeling depressed or lost interest in my usual activities. My main struggle is just this constant, overwhelming worry that I can't seem to shake.
Do these worries focus on everyday concerns like work, health, or family, or do you experience specific, repetitive thoughts that force you to perform certain rituals or routines to feel better?

It's definitely more about everyday things like my work, family, and finances rather than any specific rituals. My mind just constantly jumps from one of these daily life concerns to the next, and I can't seem to stop it.
When you are feeling this anxious, do you also experience physical symptoms like muscle tension, trouble sleeping, feeling easily fatigued, or restlessness?

To be honest, I haven't really noticed or paid much attention to physical symptoms like muscle tension or trouble sleeping. My mind is just so consumed by the constant, uncontrollable worrying that I can't seem to focus on anything else.
Since your mind is so focused on these worries, have you noticed if you've been feeling more irritable lately, or if you feel constantly on edge?
I haven't really noticed feeling particularly irritable or on edge. It's more that my mind is just completely consumed by the constant, endless worries themselves.
Did these worries start after a specific stressful event or major change in your life, or did they seem to develop on their own?

I'm really not sure of any specific stressful event or major change that triggered all of this. It feels like these worries just developed on their own and have slowly built up over the last eight months.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating on tasks, or does your mind ever feel like it goes blank because of these constant worries?

Yes, I have a lot of trouble concentrating. Worries suddenly barge into my mind out of nowhere, completely hijacking my focus when I am trying to work or get things done. It makes it really hard to stay on task.
Even if you haven't paid close attention to physical symptoms, have you noticed any trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up feeling unrefreshed because of these worries?
I haven't really noticed any significant sleep issues, to be honest. I'm not entirely sure if my sleep has been affected by these worries, since my mind is just so focused on the thoughts themselves.
Do you find that you get tired or fatigued more easily than usual lately, even if you haven't been doing much physical activity?
No, I haven't particularly noticed feeling unusually tired or fatigued lately. My energy levels seem okay, it's really just my mind that feels overwhelmed by the constant worrying.
You mentioned earlier that you hadn't paid much attention to physical symptoms, but if you think about it now, do you often notice your muscles feeling tight, tense, or sore?
I haven't really noticed any muscle tightness or soreness. I'm not sure if that's happening to me, since my mind is always just so focused on my worries.
